about: BV1 resource-variable admission. TestBindMappingProperty generates Go method sets and checks the binding against the interop table.

mutants.name: BV1 resource variables remain refused
mutants.rule: Resource-typed package variables are admitted as borrows.

mutants.name: BV1 ordinary host state admitted
mutants.rule: Non-resource, non-error variables remain refused.

mutants.name: BV1 any Close result makes a resource
mutants.rule: Close must return nothing or error alone.

mutants.name: BV1 package pointers silently promise non-nil
mutants.rule: A variable can be nil; map a resource pointer to Option[go.Ref[T]].

mutants.name: ffi-derive-reads-on-mutates
mutants.rule: A parameter Go says the function writes is never reads.

mutants.name: ffi-derive-reads-on-leak-to-result
mutants.rule: A parameter whose memory the result shares is never reads.

mutants.name: ffi-derive-any-verdict-is-reads

mutants.rule: Only the exact line `p does not escape, mutate, or call` is the reads fact; any other verdict is no fact.

mutants.name: ffi-derive-wrong-parameter
mutants.rule: A fact names the binder of the Go parameter it is about, past a hidden context.Context.

mutants.name: ffi-derive-map-reads

mutants.name: exc1-bind-close-param
mutants.rule: ergo bind go writes implements Closer only for Close() or Close() error, never for a Close with a parameter.

mutants.name: gb1-bind-recv-own
mutants.rule: A Go method lends its receiver: ergo bind go writes own on a receiver only for the release and for a result that may hold the receiver.

mutants.name: gb1-bind-typeargs
mutants.rule: A generic result type may hold the receiver through its type arguments (iter.Seq[Value]), as the checker reads Seq[Value].

mutants.name: gbx2-bind-writes
mutants.from: if w, ok := v1.GoWrites[target]; ok && w.Reason != ""
mutants.to: if w, ok := v1.GoWrites[target]; false && ok && w.Reason != ""
mutants.rule: A Go function of v1.GoWrites binds with the slice it writes as its result.

mutants.name: gbx2-bind-marker
mutants.rule: The binding writes the ergo:writes line the checker and the lowering read.

mutants.name: gbx5-merge-struct
mutants.from: case len(differ) > 0 && mergeStruct(&first, platforms, byName, name):
mutants.to: case len(differ) > 0 && false && mergeStruct(&first, platforms, byName, name):
mutants.rule: A Go struct whose fields differ by platform binds the fields every platform declares alike (syscall.SysProcAttr), not refused whole.

mutants.name: gbx5-merge-alike
mutants.rule: A field whose Go declaration differs by platform, or that one platform lacks, is refused as platform-specific.

mutants.name: gbx5-startprocess-lent
mutants.rule: os.StartProcess lends its ProcAttr for the call (reviewed), so a borrow &attr is admitted.

mutants.name: gbx4-bind-own-methods
mutants.rule: The methods of time.Duration, Ergo's duration, bind as functions of their receiver (DurationString).

mutants.name: gbx3-bind-vars
mutants.rule: A Go package variable of v1.GoReadOnlyVars binds as a read-only let; every other non-error, non-resource variable stays refused.

mutants.name: gbx3-bind-any-var
mutants.rule: Only a reviewed variable binds: an unreviewed Go variable is host state Go may write.

mutants.name: gb2-bind-any
mutants.rule: Go's empty interface binds as go.Any.

mutants.name: gb2-bind-any-key
mutants.rule: A go.Any keys no Map: Ergo compares no go.Any.

mutants.name: gb1-bind-no-alias
mutants.rule: A method of a resource whose result may hold the receiver (the type, a pointer, an interface, a struct field) keeps its receiver.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-type-promises
mutants.rule: A (*S, error) result is go.Ref[S] only where the binder proves it non-nil (the rule before GOBIND-NIL: http.ProxyFromEnvironment's nil, nil).

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-any-return
mutants.from: return p.pointer(r.Results[0], g) || p.errorSet(r.Results[1], g) || p.pair(r)
mutants.rule: Each return gives a non-nil pointer or a non-nil error.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-nil-error
mutants.rule: An error variable is non-nil only under its if err != nil guard, or a package variable set once to a non-nil error; nil is no error.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-moved-sentinel
mutants.rule: A package error variable some function of its package assigns is no sentinel.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-any-error-call
mutants.rule: Only errors.New and fmt.Errorf calls are non-nil errors; another error function may return nil.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-any-call
mutants.from: return fn != nil && fn.kind == k && p.w.proven[t]
mutants.rule: A delegated call proves the result only when its callee is proven.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-greatest-fixpoint
mutants.from: return fn != nil && fn.kind == k && p.w.proven[t]
mutants.to: return fn != nil && fn.kind == k && (p.w.proven[t] || t == p.fn.target())
mutants.rule: The proof is a least fixed point: a function whose verdict reads itself proves nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-or-guard

mutants.rule: Only an && of err != nil holds err non-nil in the body; an || does not.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-guard-reassigned
mutants.rule: A guard the if body assigns proves nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-var-any-assign
mutants.rule: A variable is non-nil only when every assignment of it is.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-unchecked-call
mutants.rule: p, err := g() proves p only when the next statement returns on err != nil.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-bare-return
mutants.from: return false // a named result's bare return
mutants.to: return true // a named result's bare return
mutants.rule: A named result's bare return proves nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-receiver
mutants.rule: A parameter or receiver may be nil.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-closure-returns
mutants.rule: A function literal's returns are not the function's.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-interface-type
mutants.rule: A conversion to, or a value of, a named interface type (type EI error) may be a nil error.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-var-as-const
mutants.rule: Only a constant is a non-nil error whatever happens; a variable may be set nil.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-any-error-func
mutants.rule: An error function's result is a non-nil error only when every return of it is.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-typed-any
mutants.rule: Only a value of a concrete type makes a non-nil error; one of an interface type may be nil.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-typed-off
mutants.to: if t := p.exprType(x); false && t != "" && p.w.types[t] {
mutants.rule: A nil *E in an error is a non-nil error (Go's typed nil); the rule proves it.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-path-guard-late
mutants.from:
for _, s := range list {
					walk(s, inner)
mutants.to:
for _, s := range list {
					walk(s, guards{names: inner.names, paths: paths})
mutants.rule: A field path's check holds only for a return that is the if body's first statement: a call before it may clear the field.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-init-guard-neq
mutants.rule: if x, err := g(); err == nil proves x; err != nil does not.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-init-guard-unproven
mutants.rule: An init guard proves x only for a proven g.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-nil-guard
mutants.rule: x != nil proves x in the body; x == nil does not.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-pair-unproven
mutants.rule: return x, err is proven only as the results of a proven call.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-pair-broken
mutants.rule: A pair a later statement reassigns is no longer one call's results.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-pkg-pointer-set
mutants.from: return v != nil && !v.set && v.value != nil && pointerValue(v.value)
mutants.to: return v != nil && v.value != nil && pointerValue(v.value)
mutants.rule: A package pointer variable some function assigns may be nil.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-nilfix-maybe
mutants.rule: if x == nil { x = maybe() } fixes nothing: the new value may be nil.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-nilfix-before
mutants.rule: A nil check proves x only for the statements after it.
